[[National Pension System]]{{cite web|url=https://www.reliancecapital.co.in/|title=Welcome to Reliance Capital|website=reliancecapital.co.in|access-date=11 April 2020|archive-date=30 August 2019|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190830041016/https://www.reliancecapital.co.in/|url-status=live}} | parent = IndusInd International Holdings Ltd ([[Hinduja Group]]) | website = {{url|www.reliancecapital.co.in}} | footnotes = }} '''IndusInd Capital Limited''' (formerly ''Reliance Capital'') is an Indian [[financial services]] company.{{cite web |url=http://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/business/india-business/reliance-capital-q4-net-at-rs-417-crore/articleshow/58401480.cms |title=Reliance Capital Q4 Results: Reliance Capital Q4 net at Rs 417 crore - Times of India |website=timesofindia.indiatimes.com |access-date=13 January 2022 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170428055822/http://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/business/india-business/reliance-capital-q4-net-at-rs-417-crore/articleshow/58401480.cms |archive-date=28 April 2017 |url-status=dead}}{{cite web|url=https://www.business-standard.com/article/news-ians/reliance-capital-q4-net-at-rs-417-crore-117042701057_1.html|title=Reliance Capital Q4 net at Rs 417 crore|date=27 April 2017|work=Business Standard|access-date=11 April 2020|archive-date=11 April 2020|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200411164410/https://www.business-standard.com/article/news-ians/reliance-capital-q4-net-at-rs-417-crore-117042701057_1.html|url-status=live}} It has businesses in [[asset management]], [[mutual funds]], [[life insurance]] and [[general insurance]], [[commercial finance]], home finance, [[stock broking]], [[wealth management]] services, distribution of financial products, [[private equity]], asset reconstruction, proprietary investments and other activities in financial services. ==History== IndusInd Capital was incorporated in 1986 at [[Ahmedabad]] in [[Gujarat]] as ''Reliance Capital & Finance Trust Limited''. After its name was changed to Reliance Capital (RC) on January 5, 1995, it obtained its registration as a non-banking company (NBFC) in December 1998.{{cite web|url=http://www.bseindia.com/downloads/ipo/2009720142048Rel%20cap%20INFORMATION%20MEMORANDUM%20-%20862%20crore%20-%20final.pdf|title=Reliance Capital NBFC|publisher=BSE|date=12 May 2009|accessdate=4 July 2014|archive-date=23 September 2015|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150923221317/http://www.bseindia.com/downloads/ipo/2009720142048Rel%20cap%20INFORMATION%20MEMORANDUM%20-%20862%20crore%20-%20final.pdf|url-status=live}} Having shifted its registered office to Jamnagar in Gujarat, Reliance Capital finally moved to [[Mumbai]] in [[Maharashtra]] four years later.{{cite web|url=http://www.reliancecapital.co.in/about_chistory.html|title=Reliance Capital Board |publisher=Reliance Capital|date=12 May 2011 |accessdate=4 July 2014}} In 2006, it merged with Reliance Capital Ventures, increasing its shareholder base from 0.15 million to 1.3 million. RC entered the capital market with a maiden public issue in 1990 and in subsequent years further tapped the capital market through rights issue and public issues. Initially listed on the [[Ahmedabad Stock Exchange|Ahmedabad]] and Mumbai Stock Exchanges, its equity shares are listed on the latter and on the [[National Stock Exchange of India]].{{cite web|url=http://economictimes.indiatimes.com/reliance-capital-ltd/infocompanyhistory/companyid-13189.cms|title=Reliance Capital History|work=The Economic Times|date=12 May 2011|accessdate=4 July 2014|archive-date=3 July 2014|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140703222829/http://economictimes.indiatimes.com/reliance-capital-ltd/infocompanyhistory/companyid-13189.cms|url-status=live}} In 2019, auditors of [[PwC]] resigned claiming that they were not allowed to carry on their audits if Reliance prevented it from exercising independent judgment in making a report to the members of the company.{{cite web|url=https://www.businessinsider.in/anil-ambani-reliance-capital-auditor-pwc-resigns/articleshow/69750766.cms|title=The auditor to Anil Ambani firm Reliance Capital says it wasn't allowed to do its job|website=Business Insider|access-date=2019-06-17}} Although RC denied any wrongdoing, auditors revealed that the recoverable amount of {{INR}}7083 crore was in fact misappropriated intercorporate deposits from other Reliance firms.{{cite web|url=https://www.businessinsider.in/anil-ambani-owned-rel-infra-auditor-says-money-missing/articleshow/69819256.cms|title=Anil Ambani company Reliance Infra's auditors reveal all, say there is missing money on balance sheet|website=Business Insider|access-date=2019-06-17|archive-date=5 July 2019|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190705170650/https://www.businessinsider.in/anil-ambani-owned-rel-infra-auditor-says-money-missing/articleshow/69819256.cms|url-status=dead}} The Indian firm had [[Anil Ambani]] as its promoter and chairman until November 2021, when the [[Reserve Bank of India]] (RBI) superseded the RC board in view of [[Default (finance)|payment defaults]] and serious governance issues. In December 2025, nine months after being sold to the [[Hinduja Group]],{{cite news |title=Reliance Capital finally comes under Hinduja fold |url=https://indianexpress.com/article/business/reliance-capital-finally-comes-under-hinduja-fold-9893410/ |access-date=8 July 2025 |work=The Indian Express |date=19 March 2025 |language=en |archive-date=8 July 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250708214426/https://indianexpress.com/article/business/reliance-capital-finally-comes-under-hinduja-fold-9893410/ |url-status=live }} the company changed its name to IndusInd Capital Limited. == Operations == Reliance Capital's prominent businesses are as follows:{{cite web|url=http://www.business-standard.com/stocks/company-overview/1866-reliance-capital|title=Reliance Capital Rating|work=Business Standard|date=12 July 2014|accessdate=14 July 2014|archive-date=15 July 2014|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140715002937/http://www.business-standard.com/stocks/company-overview/1866-reliance-capital|url-status=live}} ===Reliance General Insurance=== {{Infobox company | name = Reliance General Insurance Company Limited | logo = File:Reliance General Insurance.jpg | type = [[Private company|Private]] | founded = 2001 | hq_location = [[Mumbai]], [[India]] | industry = [[Insurance]] | products = [[General insurance|General]], [[Vehicle insurance|vehicle]], [[Health insurance|health]], [[Travel insurance|travel]], and [[home insurance]] | key_people = Rakesh Jain, Executive Director and CEO | net_income = | num_employees = | parent = Reliance Capital | website = {{url|https://www.reliancegeneral.co.in}} }} {{main|Reliance General Insurance}} [[Reliance General Insurance]] Company Limited is an Indian [[insurance company]], part of Reliance Capital Ltd. The firm has a 7.3% market share in the private sector and has the largest agency channel, with over 24,500 agents. The CEO and Executive Director is Rakesh Jain.{{cite web|url=https://www.financialexpress.com/market/reliance-general-insurance-ipo-inches-ahead-files-draft-papers-with-sebi/807599/|title=Reliance General Insurance IPO inches ahead; company files draft papers with IRDA|date=14 August 2017|access-date=11 April 2020|archive-date=11 April 2020|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200411164408/https://www.financialexpress.com/market/reliance-general-insurance-ipo-inches-ahead-files-draft-papers-with-sebi/807599/|url-status=live}} The company has strengthened and diversified its distribution network by forging partnerships with major banks. Reliance General Insurance is an active participant in various government crop insurance schemes, including the Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojna, and has insured over 3 million farmers under this financial inclusion initiative. The total gross written premium (GWP) for the year which ended 31 March 2017, was {{INRconvert|40.07|b}}.{{cite news|url=https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/business/india-business/reliance-general-insurance-eyes-acquisition/articleshow/58613282.cms|title=Reliance General Insurance: Reliance General Insurance eyes acquisition – Times of India|website=The Times of India|date=10 May 2017|archive-date=11 January 2019|access-date=11 April 2020|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190111020939/https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/business/india-business/reliance-general-insurance-eyes-acquisition/articleshow/58613282.cms|url-status=live}}{{cite web|url=https://www.financialexpress.com/money/reliance-general-insurance-logs-rs-4007-cr-premium-in-fy17/644390/|title=Reliance General Insurance logs Rs 4,007 cr premium in FY17|date=27 April 2017|access-date=11 April 2020|archive-date=11 April 2020|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200411164405/https://www.financialexpress.com/money/reliance-general-insurance-logs-rs-4007-cr-premium-in-fy17/644390/|url-status=live}} Reliance General Insurance (RGI) offers insurance for auto, health, home, property, travel, marine, commercial and other specialty products.{{cite web|url=http://articles.economictimes.indiatimes.com/2013-07-12/news/40536462_1_reliance-general-insurance-gross-written-premium-april-june-period |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20130720075827/http://articles.economictimes.indiatimes.com/2013-07-12/news/40536462_1_reliance-general-insurance-gross-written-premium-april-june-period |url-status=dead |archive-date=20 July 2013 |title=Reliance General Q1 gross written premium up 25% at Rs 706 crore |work=The Economic Times|accessdate=2013-07-30}} ===Reliance Commercial Finance=== Reliance Commercial Finance is among the leading lenders in the Indian non-banking finance sector. The CEO and Executive Director of the company is Devang Mody.{{cite web|url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/industry/banking/finance/reliance-commercial-finance-appoints-devang-mody-as-ceo/articleshow/57628320.cms|title=Reliance Commercial Finance appoints Devang Mody as CEO|date=14 March 2017|work=The Economic Times|access-date=11 April 2020|archive-date=5 January 2021|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210105055437/https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/industry/banking/finance/reliance-commercial-finance-appoints-devang-mody-as-ceo/articleshow/57628320.cms|url-status=live}} The company has an operational presence of over 44 locations in India and an AUM of 16759 Cr. as in March 2017. Reliance Commercial Finance offers a wide range of products which include business expansion loans, property loans, vehicle loans, construction equipment loans, infrastructure, microfinance and agriculture loans. The company had a loan book at ₹124.36 billion (US$2.1 billion) as on 31 March 2017, with over 268,278 customers (including microfinance) across India. ===Reliance Home Finance Limited=== Ravindra Sudhalkar is the CEO and Executive Director of the company.{{cite web|last1=India|first1=Press Trust of|url=https://www.business-standard.com/article/pti-stories/ravindra-sudhalkar-is-reliance-home-finance-s-new-ceo-116100300575_1.html|title=Ravindra Sudhalkar is Reliance Home Finance's new CEO|agency=Press Trust of India|date=3 October 2016|work=Business Standard|access-date=11 April 2020|archive-date=11 April 2020|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200411164408/https://www.business-standard.com/article/pti-stories/ravindra-sudhalkar-is-reliance-home-finance-s-new-ceo-116100300575_1.html|url-status=live}} Reliance Home Finance Limited (RHF), a 100% subsidiary of Reliance Capital, provides home loans, LAP, construction finance, and affordable housing loans. Asset Reconstruction=== Reliance Asset Reconstruction is an asset reconstruction company, the principal sponsor/shareholder of which is [[Reliance Group]] (through Reliance Capital). The AUM as on 31 March 2017, stands at Rs. 1,829 crore (previous year: Rs. 1488 crore).{{cite web|url=https://www.reliancecapital.co.in/Reliance-Asset-Reconstruction.aspx|title=Asset Reconstruction-Reliance Capital|website=reliancecapital.co.in}} === Reliance Health Insurance === Ravi Vishwanath is the CEO and Executive Director of Reliance Health Insurance.{{cite web|url=https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/money-and-banking/reliance-health-insurance-gets-final-nod-from-irdai/article25137192.ece|title=Reliance Health Insurance gets final nod from IRDAI|website=@businessline|date=5 October 2018|language=en|access-date=2019-05-28|archive-date=20 September 2022|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220920171840/https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/money-and-banking/reliance-health-insurance-gets-final-nod-from-irdai/article25137192.ece|url-status=live}} Reliance Health Insurance is a Standalone [[Health Insurance]] Company promoted solely by Reliance Capital It was established on 7 May 2017. The company is headquartered in [[Mumbai, Maharashtra]] and has started operations on 10 December 2018.{{Cite news|url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/industry/banking/finance/insure/reliance-health-insurance-gets-final-nod-from-irdai-to-start-operations/articleshow/66082743.cms|title=Reliance Health Insurance gets final nod from Irdai to start operations|date=2018-10-05|work=The Economic Times|access-date=2019-05-28|archive-date=20 May 2019|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190520202013/https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/industry/banking/finance/insure/reliance-health-insurance-gets-final-nod-from-irdai-to-start-operations/articleshow/66082743.cms|url-status=live}}{{cite web|url=https://www.reliancehealthinsurance.com/|title=Reliance Health Insurance|access-date=16 May 2019|archive-date=26 September 2019|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190926020026/https://www.reliancehealthinsurance.com/|url-status=dead}} ==Major deals== In 2011, Reliance Capital sold 26% stake in its life insurance business, Reliance Life Insurance, to [[Nippon Life]] Insurance (Nissay), amongst the world's largest life insurers, with an AUM of over $600 billion. The transaction was completed at Rs. 3,082 crore for a 26 per cent stake, valuing Reliance Life Insurance at $2.6 billion.{{cite web |url=http://www.reliancecapital.co.in/pdf/MEDIA_RELEASE_Deal_Closure_Final_Rel_Logo.pdf |title=Reliance Life Nippon Life |publisher=Reliance Capital |date=9 October 2011 |accessdate=15 July 2014 |archive-date=7 April 2014 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140407083833/http://www.reliancecapital.co.in/pdf/MEDIA_RELEASE_Deal_Closure_Final_Rel_Logo.pdf |url-status=live }}{{cite web|url=https://online.wsj.com/news/articles/SB10001424052748704893604576200042961691836 |title=Reliance Life Nippon Life |work=The Wall Street Journal |date=9 October 2011 |accessdate=15 July 2014}} In 2012, Nippon Life Insurance bought 26% stake in Reliance Capital Asset Management for Rs. 1,450 crore. Reports indicate that Reliance Capital is also planning to sell a 26% stake in its general insurance business, Reliance General Insurance, at an appropriate time.{{cite web |url=http://www.thehindubusinessline.com/industry-and-economy/banking/reliance-capital-says-no-to-stake-sale-in-nonlife-business/article5344124.ece |title=Reliance General stake sale |work=Business Line |date=12 November 2013 |accessdate=1 April 2014 |url-status=dead |archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20140407082629/http://www.thehindubusinessline.com/industry-and-economy/banking/reliance-capital-says-no-to-stake-sale-in-nonlife-business/article5344124.ece |archivedate=7 April 2014}} India's leading financial daily ''Economic Times'' wrote, "Since Reliance General Insurance is one of the leading players with 8.4 per cent market share, the proposed stake sale is expected to generate handsome capital gains for Reliance Capital... IndusInd Capital Limited (formerly Reliance Capital) is an Indian financial services company.
It has businesses in asset management, mutual funds, life insurance and general insurance, commercial finance, home finance, stock broking, wealth management services, distribution of financial products, private equity, asset reconstruction, proprietary investments and other activities in financial services.
